info.name: DMoney API Testing
info.description: Integration tests for the DMoney user and transaction APIs (Batch 20 assignment). Flow: create 2 customers, 1 agent and 1 merchant, activate them as admin, deposit 5000 tk from SYSTEM to the agent, agent deposits 2000 tk to a customer (commission asserted), customer sends 1000 tk (fee asserted), other customer cashes out 500 tk (fee asserted) and pays 400 tk to the merchant. Run the folders in order: later requests use tokens and ids stored by earlier ones.

item.name: 0. Authentication
item.description: Logs in the admin and the SYSTEM account.

request.description: Admin login. The returned token is used to create and activate users.
SYSTEM account login (system@dmoney.com / 1234). The token is used for the first deposit to the agent.
